rules.rationale: Eczema background, fever, vesicular rash, and immunosuppression point to viral confirmation and secondary infection assessment.

rules.rationale: Photosensitive rash, inflammatory joint symptoms, mucosal or hair findings, and renal risk point to autoimmune activity and organ-involvement assessment.

rules.rationale: Fever or chills with urinary irritation and retention or perineal symptoms point to acute prostatitis, requiring severity, pathogen, susceptibility, and complication assessment.

评估感染严重度

排查脓肿、尿潴留或复杂情况
